exam_description: Official IELC IELTS Academic Placement Test covering 4 modules: Listening (30 mins, 40 questions), Reading (60 mins, 40 questions), Writing Task 1 & Task 2 (60 mins), and Speaking (11-14 mins interactive interview with a certified instructor).

tasks.title: IELTS Academic Listening Section (4 Sections, 40 Questions)
tasks.description:
The IELTS® Listening Section is designed to measure your ability to understand conversations and lectures in English.

  • There are 4 sections in the Listening test (40 Questions in total).
  • The test duration is approximately 30 minutes under real test conditions.
  • Listen carefully, as the audio track will be played only once.
  • Follow the question booklet on the left and enter your answers in the digital answer sheet (1–40) on the right.

tasks.title: IELTS Academic Reading Section (3 Passages, 40 Questions)
tasks.description:
The IELTS® Reading Section is designed to measure your ability to understand academic passages in English.

  • There are 3 Reading Passages in this test (40 Questions in total).
  • The test duration is 60 minutes.
  • Read the passages and instructions in the booklet on the left and enter your answers into the digital answer sheet (1–40) on the right.
  • Pay attention to word count limits in the instructions (e.g. NO MORE THAN TWO WORDS, TRUE/FALSE/NOT GIVEN).

tasks.title: IELTS Academic Writing Task 1 (Short Report)
tasks.description:
Task 1: Report on a Graph / Chart

You should spend about 20 minutes on this task.

Prompt: The graph below shows the contribution of three sectors – agriculture, manufacturing, and business and financial services – to the UK economy in the twentieth century.

Summarize the information by selecting and reporting the main features, and make comparisons where relevant.

Requirements:

  • Write in a formal academic style.
  • Write at least 150 words.
  • You can view the full question booklet & diagram on the left.
  • Type your report directly in the essay editor on the right.

tasks.title: IELTS Academic Writing Task 2 (Discursive Essay)
tasks.description:
Task 2: Academic Essay

You should spend about 40 minutes on this task.

Topic: To some people, studying the past has little value in the modern world. Why do you think it is important to do so? What will be the effect if children are not taught history?

Give reasons for your answer and include any relevant examples from your own experience or knowledge.

Requirements:

  • Write in a formal academic style.
  • Write at least 250 words.
  • Type your essay directly in the text editor on the right, or upload your document.

tasks.title: IELTS Speaking Interview & Discussion
tasks.description:
The IELTS® Speaking Section is designed to measure your ability to speak English effectively in both academic and general settings.

In the Speaking test, you will have a 1-on-1 interactive discussion with an experienced certified examiner. The test is approximately 11–14 minutes long and divided into 3 parts:

  1. Part 1 (Introduction & Interview): You will answer questions about yourself, your hobbies, studies/work, and everyday topics.
  2. Part 2 (Individual Long Turn): You will be given a topic card with 1 minute to prepare, and speak for 1–2 minutes.
  3. Part 3 (Two-way Discussion): A deeper discussion with the examiner exploring abstract issues related to Part 2.

ℹ️ The speaking test will be conducted live online with one of our experienced certified examiners during your scheduled consultation appointment. See you there!
